name: golviva
description: Football match predictions for every game of Europe's top leagues and its club competitions (win, draw and loss chances, likeliest scores, likely scorers, predicted line-ups), season projections with each club's title, top-four and relegation chances, and independent player valuations with the reasons behind them — plus live scores, match centres, league tables, stat leaders and transfer news. Ask who will win a match or the league, what any player is really worth and why, and follow scores and tables — all read-only.
